integrity: The proof is symbolic and self-contained up to standard symplectic extension and group-order lemmas. The finite checker is packaged and replayable. Classical symplectic orbit and isotropic Grassmannian facts are credited; independence is not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Only nondegenerate alternating multiplication tensors over characteristic-two finite fields; all unital base-field subalgebras. The result does not classify odd-characteristic, nonalternating, or degenerate cases. Finite enumerations corroborate but do not prove generality.
title: Symplectic subalgebra spectra of characteristic-two short Gorenstein algebras
